errors.evidence: The chart shows five sections for each bar, corresponding to five categories in the legend. The description incorrectly states there are four.
The description omits one of the five heating sources shown in the legend and the chart: "Въглища" (Coal), which is represented by the yellow segments.

For the "Общо" category, the description incorrectly assigns the value for "Въглища" (Coal), which is 19.8%, to "Отопление от централен източник" (District heating), which is actually 16.4%. It also incorrectly assigns the value for "Отопление от централен източник" (16.4%) to "Газ" (Gas), which is actually 0.7%.

For the "Градовете" category, the description incorrectly assigns the value for "Въглища" (Coal), which is 14.9%, to "Отопление от централен източник" (District heating). It also incorrectly assigns the value for "Отопление от централен източник" (22.7%) to "Газ" (Gas), which is actually 0.9%.

For the "Селата" category, the description incorrectly assigns the value for "Въглища" (Coal), which is 32.4%, to "Отопление от централен източник" (District heating). The actual value for district heating in villages is 0.2%.
